open_items: ILO resolved: provider_down at cycle 1162 (403 across gateway and direct paths) recovered by cycle 1163 and stayed healthy through 1165. Live recheck at this run confirmed 3x 200, no flapping. Consistent with the documented self-resolving ILO 403 flap pattern.

UNICEF resolved: provider_down at cycle 1162 (503 across all paths) recovered by cycle 1163 and stayed healthy through 1165. Second 503 flap in ~26h (cycles 1149 and 1162); no third occurrence followed as of this run.

ABS flapped: gateway_issue at cycle 1164 (empty 'gateway metadata: Error:' body), recovered by cycle 1165. Sixth confirmed occurrence of this exact shape (cycle 26, ~997, 1087, 1140, 1144, 1164). Root cause still traced to tools/sdmx_tools.py:208-210 feeding main_server.py:477; not fixed by this routine. Live recheck reproduced ABS's listing endpoint stalling twice at 30s then succeeding with a 3.2MB payload, consistent with a timeout being the proximate trigger.
ABS encoding:structure_xml Content-Type charset/version parameter order flipped cosmetically this cycle (same pattern previously seen on ILO/OECD); verdict stayed ok, not an incident.
STATSNZ auth:listing capability_appeared, first seen cycle 60, still present at cycle 1165. Still open, not re-reported since no new change.
110 claude/ triage branches on origin as of this run (up from 109 at cycle 1162). Still above the 20 the skill flags for pruning; not actioned by this read-only routine.

main is still only through cycle 1147's PR (#314). The cycle 1162 ALERT entry was stranded on an unmerged branch (claude/sleepy-dijkstra-j48tkg) and has been folded into docs/monitor/incidents.md by this run so the record stays complete even if this run's own PR also fails to merge.

Long-running architectural facts, not incidents: ILO /availableconstraint/ returns 500 (constraints come via ?references=all); ESTAT has no practical constraint support; ESTAT direct json check is skipped by design (Eurostat returns 406 for SDMx-JSON); BIS/ILO/IMF references:contentconstraint reads ignored (accepted and silently dropped); ABS/ILO/OECD encoding:structure_xml Content-Type charset/version parameter order flips cosmetically from time to time, verdict always stays ok.
